entries.213ac369d7adfeb8: A snack food manufacturer headquartered in Kita Ward, Tokyo. The company and five consolidated subsidiaries form the group, and consolidated employees as of the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 815. Listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.25a483ce76c800fa: The management philosophy is “Through freedom-minded, fair and moderate corporate activities, to create and develop food culture and achieve customer satisfaction, shareholder returns and social contribution,” and the corporate message is “A Pinch of Happiness.” Under the 6th Medium-Term Management Plan “Next Value up for 80,” covering the fiscal years ended March 2023 through March 2028, the company aims for its 80th-term vision of “a company that delivers snacks that are ‘more’ delicious, fun and exciting,” and is pursuing three priority strategies: expanding Natori fans through snacks offering new enjoyment, building a workplace where all personnel can thrive and find their work rewarding, and addressing the SDGs while strengthening governance.
entries.2c4f9a4fc1b091cb: It is a food manufacturer focused on snacks. Its main customers are food wholesalers, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were accounted for by Konfekkusu Co., Ltd. (16.2%), Mitsubishi Shokuhin Co., Ltd. (14.3%) and Yamaboshiya Co., Ltd. (10.9%). It has no external customers outside Japan.
entries.473eb3144c55d70a: The Food Manufacturing and Sales Business accounts for more than 99% of revenue, and snack foods are the axis of growth. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, dairy processed products rose 6.7% year on year and agricultural processed products rose 11.6%, driven by new products suited to snacking demand, while marine processed products fell 3.8% due to a temporary drop in sales volume after price revisions.
